# YAAD

> YAAD (yaadapppk) is a simple, private smart shopping list and grocery memory assistant made for everyday grocery shopping in Pakistan. It supports English, Nastaliq Urdu, and Roman Urdu with 100% offline functionality.

## Core Information & Public Pages

- [YAAD Homepage](https://yaadapppk.vercel.app/): Official web application and interactive shopping list assistant.
- [About YAAD](https://yaadapppk.vercel.app/about): Background, mission, and story behind the Pakistani grocery assistant.
- [Monthly Rashan List Guide](https://yaadapppk.vercel.app/rashan-list): Curated monthly grocery checklist tailored for Pakistani households with family-size scaling.
- [Features Overview](https://yaadapppk.vercel.app/features): Detailed overview of offline capabilities, bilingual categorization, and smart memory features.
- [How YAAD Works](https://yaadapppk.vercel.app/how-it-works): Guide to making shopping lists, organizing aisles, and checking off items offline.
- [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)](https://yaadapppk.vercel.app/faq): Answers to common questions regarding offline sync, privacy, and account usage.
- [Grocery & Shopping Guides (Blog)](https://yaadapppk.vercel.app/blog): Helpful guides on shopping planning, Pakistani unit conversions, and grocery budgeting.
- [Privacy Policy](https://yaadapppk.vercel.app/privacy): Commitment to private data storage and zero ad-tracking.
- [Terms of Service](https://yaadapppk.vercel.app/terms): Clear and transparent terms of service for application users.
- [Legal Information Hub](https://yaadapppk.vercel.app/legal): Comprehensive compliance and legal information.

## Key Capabilities

- **Bilingual & Roman Urdu Recognition**: Recognizes grocery items in English, Urdu (آلو, پیاز, دودھ), and Roman Urdu (aloo, pyaaz, doodh).
- **Pakistani Units Support**: Built-in support for kg, gram, pao, adha kilo, sawa kilo, darjan, and local packaging units.
- **Offline-First Resilience**: Full list creation, item checking, and editing in basement markets without cellular connectivity.
- **Private & Secure**: Zero third-party ad networks, private encrypted user data, and transparent data ownership.
